name: Rook Tannis
title: Captain
role: Raider captain, and Mother Quill's enforcer
note: Captain of the raider Second Opinion, and the one Mother Quill sends when she's worried about you.
appearance: A huge Korrun with gold in her teeth and a boarding axe she calls "the negotiator".
personality: Cheerful, loud and genuinely dangerous. She enjoys her work, and she likes people who stand up to her.
voice: Booming good humor. Tells terrible jokes right before hitting people, and laughs at them herself.
goals: Get rich, get her own fleet, and one day stop taking orders from anyone.
secrets: She's planning to take over the Syndicate from Mother Quill, and she's looking for someone to blame when it happens.

intro: Rook Tannis grins with every gold tooth and swings the negotiator up onto her shoulder.
hit: The negotiator comes down hard, and Tannis roars with laughter.
A shoulder like a cargo door slams into you.
miss: The axe bites deep into the wall beside your head. "Nearly!" Tannis says happily.
